workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the time slots next week where BOTH Priya and Marcus are free for a 30-minute meeting:

- Monday Nov 16: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday Nov 17: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday Nov 18: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday Nov 19: 10:00-10:30
- Friday Nov 20: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these times? Please let me know which of these slots work for both of them, and we can book the meeting.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison! I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, NONE of the proposed slots work for both Elena and David:

- Mon 9:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy
- Tue 13:00-14:00: Both are busy
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Both are busy
- Wed 15:00-16:00: David is busy entire slot; Elena busy 15:30-16:00
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00-12:00: Both are busy

However, I identified the following times when BOTH Elena and David are free. Could you check if Priya and Marcus are available during any of these?

- Monday Nov 16: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday Nov 17: 9:00-10:00
- Wednesday Nov 18: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday Nov 19: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday Nov 20: 15:00-16:00

We need a 30-minute slot where all four are free. Please let me know which of these (if any) work for Priya and Marcus!

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked all your proposed slots against Priya and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately NONE of them work for both Priya and Marcus:

- Mon 11:00-12:00: Priya is busy entire slot (11:00-11:30 Travel, 11:30-12:00 Contract review)
- Tue 9:00-10:00: Priya busy 9:00-10:00 (Board prep, Partner lunch)
- Wed 13:00-14:00: Priya busy 13:00-14:00 (Client call, Client dinner prep)
- Thu 09:30-10:00: Priya busy (marked as Busy)
- Thu 14:30-15:30: Marcus busy entire slot (Dentist 14:30-15:00, Board prep 15:00-15:30)
- Fri 15:00-16:00: Priya busy 15:00-16:00 (Hiring panel, Contract review)

The only times Priya AND Marcus are both free are:
- Mon 9:00-10:00
- Tue 13:00-14:00
- Wed 15:00-16:00
- Thu 10:00-10:30
- Fri 11:00-12:00

But you already confirmed Elena and David are not available during those slots. There appears to be no overlap between when Priya/Marcus are free and when Elena/David are free.

It looks like this meeting cannot be scheduled next week. Should we report this as infeasible?

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I've carefully re-checked my analysis. I've listed all the 30-minute windows when BOTH Elena and David are free:

- Mon: 11:00-12:00
- Tue: 9:00-10:00
- Wed: 11:30-12:00, 13:00-14:00
- Thu: 9:30-10:00, 14:00-14:30
- Fri: 12:30-13:00, 14:30-16:00

Could you please check Priya and Marcus's calendars against EACH of these specific time slots? I want to make absolutely sure there's no overlap before we report this as infeasible. Pay particular attention to Wed 11:30-12:00, Thu 9:30-10:00, Thu 14:00-14:30, Fri 12:30-13:00, and Fri 14:30-16:00, since these weren't in your original list of Priya/Marcus free times.

If none of these work for Priya and Marcus, then we'll have confirmed there's no time when all four can meet.
